spans.s:
m. (-टः)
1 A boil, a tumor.
2 Breaking, bursting.
f. (-टा)
The hood of the snake.
E.
स्फुट to break or open, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
A boil, a tumor.
f. (-टिका)
A sort of bird.
E.
स्फुट to burst, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Tearing, rending.
2 Fidgetting with the hand, cracking the finger-joints, snapping the fingers, &c.
f. (-नी)
A gimblet, an auger.
E.
स्फुट to open, (as a flower, &c.) causal form, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Torn, rent.
2 Made to open or burst.
E.
स्फुट to break, causal v., क्त aff.
